If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, apply a 0.3–0.7% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days) to align with observed mean reversion.

When sentiment swings from positive to negative within 5 days, reduce forecast slope by 15–25% for the next 7 days.

If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days and forecast is rising, cap upward momentum at +1.5% above recent peak for late horizon.

If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days and forecast is falling, cap downward momentum at -1.5% below recent trough for early horizon.
